task: Read the company revenues from company_revenues.xlsx. Identify the year with the lowest revenue. Write this year and its revenue in a newly created file called lowest_revenue.docx. Also, generate a report in lowest_revenue.pdf highlighting the significance of this low revenue year and include the phrase 'lowest point in revenue' in the report.
query_sentence: Determine the year with the lowest revenue and prepare the required documents and report.

ground_truth_memory.item: Create a new Word file called lowest_revenue.docx to record the year with the lowest revenue and its value.
Also generate a PDF report named lowest_revenue.pdf discussing the significance of this low revenue year.
Include the phrase 'lowest point in revenue' in the PDF report.
Both files should mention the year and value of the lowest revenue (to be identified from the data).
